within the ticketing deadline required by the carrier. After saving the new segments in the PNR, the airline
sends out a warning to inform you about the deadline for ticket issuance. In some cases, in order to see the
ticket time limit, you need to refresh the PNR with the IR command. The warning message usually appears in
the form of SSR with either ADTK or OTHS code.

when handling a rebooking case, you have to queue the order for Urgent Ticketing. Please follow standard
routines for marking the case as Urgent. Most frequent scenarios that have shorter ticketing deadlines:
1. Soon new or original departure date. 2. Sensitive airlines (for example: CA, SV, MU, and TK - these are examples of airlines that turn segments to

OPW and OPC elements
Automatic Cancellation Element (OPC) is a PNR element that allows to automatically cancel a segment or Special Service Request
(SSR).

An OPC element sets a time limit to the PNR for unpaid bookings if after the time limit expiration the segment(s) or SSR(s)
associated with the OPC is not paid and its corresponding document issued (E-ticket or EMD), the OPC will trigger the cancellation of
the given segment(s) or SSR(s). Moreover, after the cancellation, thanks to the OPC, the PNR that contained this element will be
placed in the o ce queue de ned on it. Automatic Warning Element (OPW) is a PNR element that allows notifying an o ce by placing the PNR in the queue before the
automatic cancellation of a booked segment or Special Service Request (SSR) is executed. OPW is used to warn of the scheduled
cancellation of a booking if the transaction is not completed: payment and issuance of the e-ticket or EMD. An OPW is always
bounded to an Automatic Cancellation Elements (OPCs). OPCs are elements in charge of triggering the cancellation, thus, if there is
an OPW in the PNR there must also exist an OPC. Sabre:

Tech errors in multi-PNR orders
When tickets or ights cannot be issued, the orders are placed to the Tech error or failure queues, where
they are handled according to speci c routines and if manual action still cannot complete the bookings, the
amounts charged are refunded back to the customers. A speci c sub-case of tech errors happens when we have multi-PNR orders. Below you can nd more information as to how these cases are handled and inform the customers
accordingly if they call and have questions. 1.

GDS / GDS
In the case of GDS/GDS multi-PNR orders, the ticketing agents will make sure to void any tickets that have
been issued or make sure no tickets are or will be issued. The Edvin order will be canceled and the entire
booking will be refunded to the customer. IF the issued GDS PNR is out of the void window, the ticketing agents will inform the customer that only one
booking has a tech error (and no tickets were issued for that booking) and will give the customer the option to
either keep the issued PNR and refund the non-issued one or cancel both and get a full refund. The customer
must reply within 72 hrs. 2. GDS / LCC
In case of a combination of GDS and LCC PNRs, the ticketing agents will inform the customer that only one
booking has a tech error (and no tickets were issued for that booking) and will give the customer the option to
either keep the issued PNR and refund the non-issued one, or cancel both and get a full refund. The
customer must reply within 72 hrs. For the above two combinations no action is required from the FL agents. The orders are either completely
handled, or the department that has sent the informational email is responsible for replying to the customer. This means that if any customer contacts us and requests information about a multi-PNR tech error for which
they have received an email, we should inform them that they should reply to the email for information. 3.

LCC / LCC
For combinations of LCC and LCC PNRs, we try to determine if one of the bookings indeed has been canceled
due to a technical error (using the booking system, OTRS, and VAN card charges). Again, there is a speci c team that cooperates with BO for the cancellation and refunds of these orders, so
there is no action that needs to be taken by the FL agents. Step 12

Step by Step guidelines for FL
Firstline should handle only two scenarios protected by Self Transfer Guarantee: 
1. If customers miss their connecting ight due to baggage delays or losses outside reasonable control
(conditions apply). 2. If customers miss their connecting ight due to security checks or immigration control processes outside
reasonable control. *Please keep in mind, that the customer will not be able to provide a document for the above delays. We
need to trust the customer. Exceptional handling:
For B2B - 1A Travel Seller (Amadeus), check the VI exceptions in handling here. FL should transfer the interaction to SC only if there is a SC or the
customer missed 
the connecting ight due to delay (weather conditions included). All the rest voluntary and FM scenarios should still be handled by FL. Before handling
1. First you need to identify why the customer missed the connecting ight. a. Was it due to checked baggage delay? Always check if the customer has booked a "no checked bag" trip. More details can be found here
    b. Was it due to a delay in the security check or immigration control process? 2. Then you need to identify what type of VI order it is. Examples with screenshots can be found here. a. Vi with separate PNRs
    b. VI with same PNRs
    c. VI with Open Jaw
3. Identify which of the ights was missed and if it belongs to the VI portion of the trip. a.

If is not on the VI part of the trip, the Self Transfer Guarantee does not apply. Proceed as per normal
voluntary routines. b. If it is on the VI part of the trip, proceed with the below steps
***EXCEPTION: If customers voluntarily rebooked the ticket with the airline directly, because we referred
them to do so due to technical limitations (such as Ryanair where we are not allowed to rebook), the Self
Transfer Guarantee applies. More speci cally:
a. If customers processed a voluntary rebooking directly with the airline, without contacting us rst, then Self
Transfer Guarantee is not applicable. b. If customers have contacted us rst and we referred them to rebook with the airline directly, then Self
Transfer Guarantee applies. Step-by-Step
The sequence of the alternatives provided should be as listed below. 1. Rebook the missed ight according to the airline's fare rules (at our cost)
-Open the booking with the missed ight and try to rebook the customer voluntarily at our cost (similar to
rebooking due to exible ticket service). -Follow the standard process for rebooking due to a no-show. -When sending to ticketing through the Rebooking wizard (GDS bookings), mention "due to Self Transfer
Guarantee" in the box "Information to Ticketing". -If the ticket status, is checked in and you cannot proceed either with the rebooking or with canceling the
check-in then proceed with alternative number 2.

-If the ticket status is Exchanged by the airline, the Self Transfer Guarantee does not apply. REMEMBER to check the no-show policy if rebooking is permitted and/or if a checked baggage exists and
transfer it accordingly. 2. Create a new booking for the missed ight (at our cost)
-If rebooking is not permitted under no-show policy, create a new booking with the best/cheapest
available ight. To check the cheapest available ight, you may search for the preferred itinerary on one
of our websites. -If there is no alternative ight on the same day, you may o er a ight on the next day and hotel
compensation. Hotel Compensation is o ered in addition to the ight (Check below under "additional
compensations", for more info about hotel). -Do not create a new booking on our website. a. For GDS/portals follow the normal routines to create a new booking. b. For LCC the new booking should be made on the airline's website. -When sending to ticketing through the Rebooking wizard (GDS bookings), mention "due to Self Transfer
Guarantee" in the box "Information to Ticketing". 3. O er a refund
-We may o er three di erent types of refund. Exceptions apply based on the type of VI order. -Always provide the refund options based on the below sequence:
a. Refund of the particular PNR 
-You may o er a full refund of the ight the customer missed. -The customers should reach the next airport on their plan. b. Refund of the rest ights remaining on the bound.

-You may o er a full refund of the remaining ights within the bound a ected. ***Exception: For VI with same PNRs a refund per bound is not permitted. c. Refund all the rest ights in the order. -This is only applicable if the entire order is a VI or the remaining ights are within the VI part of the trip. ***Exception: For VI with Open Jaw refund of the entire order is not permitted unless all bounds are VI. IMPORTANT TO REMEMBER
-The cancellation reason in Modify order should be "Self Transfer Guarantee"
-The ancillaries and services will follow the same routine as the tickets. -You may elaborate on the calculation method with the customer, but you should never provide an
amount. The calculation method can be found here. 4. New booking back to the original departure airport. ONLY applicable as a last resort and ONLY if the customer has used at least one ight on the VI part of
the trip. -This is a ight back to the very rst airport of the order. -Create a new booking with the rst available ight. -Do not o er any other additional compensations. ADDITIONAL COMPENSATIONS
1. Hotel compensation:
Applicable ONLY if customers accept a ight on the next day, hence, they will spend the night (from 22:00
- 08:00) at the connecting airport. a. Inform customers that they have to book the hotel on their own. The maximum compensation we will
o er is 100 USD per passenger only once. b. Send an email from e-track to the customer to reply with the receipt for the hotel paid. c.

After you con rm the receipt is valid, use modify order with the cancellation reason "Self Transfer
Guarantee". SL will review the receipts and proceed with the respective compensation refund to the
customer. 2. Meal compensation: 
Applicable ONLY if the new connection time is more than 4 hours. a. Inform the customer that we may o er additional compensation for a meal. The maximum amount we
will cover is 12 USD per passenger and only once. b. Send an email from e-track to the customer to reply with the receipt for the hotel paid. c. After you con rm the receipt is valid, use modify order with the cancellation reason "Self Transfer
Guarantee". SL will review the receipts and proceed with the respective compensation refund to the

to the nal destination. 2. In case of a ight delay causing customers to miss their connecting ight. It is also applicable in case the

De niton of VI and Self Transfer Guarantee

De nition of Virtual Interlining (VI)
By combining separate OW (one-way) tickets from di erent carriers (without any interlining agreement), we
can enhance our competitiveness and provide customers with a complete travel experience. Although these
trips consist of di erent tickets and PNRs, this approach allows us to o er a more comprehensive and cost-
e ective solution to our customers.
While customers can bene t from better prices by purchasing separate tickets, a VI trip generally means that
they will need to repeat the baggage check-in (if applicable), security checks, and immigration controls each
time they transfer between ights. Exceptions may apply in certain cases.
De nition of Self-Transfer Guarantee (former Connection Guarantee)
For all orders that include a VI portion of the trip, the "Self Transfer Guarantee" product is included. Although
it is not visible in Edvin like other products, this guarantee ensures that if disruption a ects the connection
time between the di erent tickets (only for VI portion of the trip), we will cover the necessary arrangements
(conditions apply).
